info.title: PayResolve AI API
info.description: REST API for PayResolve AI — an intelligent merchant-side platform that detects PayPal payment exceptions (amount mismatches, missing captures, refund anomalies), derives an evidence graph linking orders, captures, webhooks, and shipments, runs an AI investigator with deterministic verification, and lets human operators approve corrective actions. Built for the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026.
